title: Sieve Bucket
description: Adds the Sieve Bucket tool, a device for sifting blocks.
body:
A utility mod that introduces block sifting mechanics to enhance resource gathering.

_New Item:_

Sieve Bucket - specialized tool for processing blocks
![Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5dd6e44c696f33142d9997b08a9e721b5ffc0a45.png)

Mesh - crafting component made from string
![Craft mesh](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f82b6bdddf0fdd9f32694103b18d935cf29abb54.png)

**How to use** 

Shift + Right-click on sand, dirt, or gravel.
The block will be used and drop random resources.

**What resources are dropped?**

_Sand_ :Rotten flesh,bone,string,gold nugget,iron nugget,diamond,emerald

_Dirt_ :Wheat seeds,beetroot seeds,bone,clay,apple,potato,carrot

_Gravel_ :Flint,iron nugget, gold nugget,slime ball,diamond,lapis lazuli,redstone,netherite scrap
